title: Cloak percentage and detection

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1245197 (0x0013000d), HLP file offset 314882 (0x0004ce02), topic 150 "Cloaking, or Hiding from an Opponent's Scanners"
provenance.note: Cloak reduces range; max 98%; same-location visibility.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1248208 (0x00130bd0), HLP file offset 317893 (0x0004d9c5), topic 151 "Detecting an Opponent's Fleets"
provenance.note: 75% cloak against 200 ly gives 50 ly effective range.

setup.baseline: A cloaked fleet and a scanner with known range.

procedure: Place a fleet at the edge of scanner range and record detection.
Test multiple cloaks and a Tachyon Detector.

documented: Cloaking reduces effective scanner range by a percentage; maximum cloak is 98% (documented-only).
A 75% cloak reduces a 200 ly scanner to 50 ly effective range (documented-only).
A cloaked object is always visible to another fleet at the same location (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact stacking/rounding and detector interaction are not fully decoded.
Super-Stealth inherent cloak interaction is unknown.
